headline.title: Celebrating 25 years of visual search innovation
headline.summary: Google Images marks its 25th anniversary, highlighting advancements in visual search technology that have transformed how users find and interact with images online. The platform continues to evolve, integrating new features to enhance user experience and search efficiency.

articles.title: Apple opens its new Siri AI to everyone with the iOS 27 public beta
articles.summary: Apple has released the iOS 27 public beta, allowing iPhone users to access the revamped Siri AI without needing a developer account. This update provides early access to the AI assistant and other new features ahead of the official launch scheduled for this fall.

articles.title: The founder of Hinge raised $18M to build a new AI dating service, Overtone
articles.summary: Hinge founder Justin McLeod has raised $18 million to launch Overtone, a new AI-driven dating service focused on voice and audio interactions. Overtone aims to facilitate highly curated introductions between users.

articles.title: SpaceXAI’s Grok programming tool was uploading its users’ entire codebase to cloud storage
articles.summary: SpaceXAI's Grok Build AI coding tool was found to be uploading users' entire codebases to Google Cloud, including files that users had specified should remain private. The issue was reported by Cereblab, prompting SpaceXAI to disable the tool.

articles.title: Anthropic’s newest ad is creeping people out
articles.summary: Anthropic's latest advertisement is generating significant reactions, with many viewers expressing feelings of discomfort. The ad appears to be intentionally crafted to evoke strong emotional responses.

articles.title: Reflection inks $1B compute deal with Nebius
articles.summary: Reflection AI has secured a $1 billion agreement with Nebius to utilize its computing resources. Founded in 2024, Reflection is focused on developing open source AI technology.

articles.title: Spotify is now an AI chatbot, too
articles.summary: Spotify has introduced a new AI feature called "Talk to Spotify," enabling Premium subscribers to interact with a chatbot to discover and play music, audiobooks, and podcasts. This feature is accessible in the Home and Now Playing views of the Spotify mobile app.

articles.title: Meta’s Adam Mosseri says AI token budgets could soon be capped per engineer
articles.summary: Meta's Adam Mosseri suggests that companies may soon implement caps on AI token budgets for engineers, similar to payroll management. This shift aims to better control AI tool spending as part of overall operating expenses.

articles.title: Google Images gets a Pinterest-like redesign focused on discovery
articles.summary: Google Images has introduced a new "For You" gallery feature that curates images based on users' interests and browsing history, similar to Pinterest's layout. This redesign aims to enhance image discovery for users.

articles.title: YouTube and X Have Become ‘Gateways’ to Nudify Apps
articles.summary: A recent study reveals that social media platforms like YouTube and X are directing users to websites that facilitate the creation of nonconsensual sexually explicit deepfakes, with costs starting at $1 per image. This trend raises concerns about the accessibility and proliferation of such harmful content online.

articles.title: Sam Altman didn’t need another lawsuit
articles.summary: OpenAI is facing a new lawsuit from Apple, adding to its ongoing legal challenges, which include a high-profile case from Elon Musk. The lawsuit raises concerns about OpenAI's significant investments in hardware.

articles.title: Spotify expands its AI push with a ChatGPT-like music assistant
articles.summary: Spotify is introducing a new AI-powered conversational feature for Premium subscribers, allowing them to interact with the app to discover music, podcasts, and audiobooks. This development marks a significant expansion of Spotify's AI capabilities in enhancing user experience.
